hints.title: Minimum Spanning Hierarchy
hints.text: This problem asks for the minimum total weight to connect all vertices into a single connected component.

hints.title: Greedy Edge Selection
hints.text: Sort all connections in ascending order of cost. Add edges between previously disconnected sets.

hints.title: Component Count Verification
hints.text: Begin with n isolated components. Each edge that joins two different roots decrements the component count. If components reach 1, return total cost; else return negative 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all possible spanning subgraphs yields exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kruskal algorithm with Disjoint Set Union provides optimal spanning tree selection in near linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize standard Minimum Spanning Tree and implement Kruskal or Prim correctly.
complexity.notes: 1-indexed city identifiers are handled directly in the parent array.
